title: Pointer to the properties of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]
text:
In the notation of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], the following holds. The perfectness assertion for this
construction, $R\Gamma_c(X,K)\in D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A)$ for every
$K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$, is
[prop-trf-compact-support-perfectness].
